name: slides
description: A carousel's headlines, one slide's edit and a new slide order, in one call. headlines: one per slide, each made (or replaced) as the editor's own text element, restyleable in its text panel. edit: one slide's headline, color, size, align, position or style. order: every slide once. A carousel with images but no slides yet gets one slide per image first. Writes the slides only, a version first; a person's edit since it read them is refused, and slides it does not touch stay as they are. Never renders.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {changed: [slide numbers, after any new order], made? (slides made from the images), headlines?: {added, replaced}, order?: true, issues?}. detail adds each changed slide's headline text and size.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: headlines
params.description: A list of headline texts, one per slide in order; null skips a slide. A headline the person retyped is kept (edit replaces it).

params.name: edit
params.description: One slide: {"slide": 3, "headline": "...", "color": "red", "size": "smaller", "align": "left", "position": "top"|"middle"|"bottom", "style": "bold"}. slide is its number (1-based) or id.

params.name: order
params.description: The new order: a list of every slide once, by number (1-based) or id, e.g. [1, 4, 3, 2, 5]. Applied after headlines and edit.

params.name: style
params.description: The headlines' look: bold (white, heavy, shadow), clean (dark text), label (dark text on a white card). Default auto: picked per slide from the image under the headline.

params.name: detail
params.description: Also answer each changed slide's headline.
